content.title: Defer library NPM publishing until release strategy is decided
content.description:
Project-level decision (owner-directed, 2026-06-17): the agentrack library will NOT be published to NPM at this stage. Release tasks must not block on NPM credentials or treat `npm publish` as a required step. The publish phase is deferred until we decide how library releases will be managed going forward (CI-driven via NPM_TOKEN, manual owner-side publish, or another mechanism).

Two phase tasks:
1. library-releaser: update release expertise so release tasks complete at the version-bump/build/commit stage; do not block on npm auth.
2. library-architect: update architecture expertise so plans do not assume NPM publish as a release deliverable; a future strategy for release management will be planned separately when needed.

content.content:

1. [mqi9fp1wf6] library-architect — update architecture expertise so plans do not assume NPM publish as a release deliverable. Unblocked.

3. [mqi9g0bia7] library-validator — validate both expertise updates for correctness/consistency. Blocked by the two tasks above.
